\chapter{Boolean Analysis --- Interpolation}
%%% generated by the blueprint pipeline from TCSlib.BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Bobkov.Interpolation
\section{Overview}
Symmetric averages of profile-vector lengths admit a contraction inequality whenever the profile satisfies the scalar two-point bound. The auxiliary squared-length parameter records the remaining displacement variance.

\section{Declarations}

\begin{definition}[Symmetric average length]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.BobkovInterpolation.pairLength}
\leanok
For a profile $P:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$, $a,b,t,c\in\mathbb R$, and $u,v\in\mathbb R^m$, define $L(t,c)=\frac12\bigl(\sqrt{P(a+tb)^2+c+\|u+tv\|_2^2}+\sqrt{P(a-tb)^2+c+\|u-tv\|_2^2}\bigr)$. The symmetric average length is $L(t,c)$.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[Symmetric interpolation deficit]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.BobkovInterpolation.pairDeficit}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.BobkovInterpolation.pairLength}
For a profile $P:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$, $a,b,t,c\in\mathbb R$, and $u,v\in\mathbb R^m$, define $L(t,c)=\frac12\bigl(\sqrt{P(a+tb)^2+c+\|u+tv\|_2^2}+\sqrt{P(a-tb)^2+c+\|u-tv\|_2^2}\bigr)$. The interpolation deficit is $\Delta(t,c)=L(t,c)-L(1,c+b^2(1-t^2))$.
\end{definition}

\begin{lemma}[Bounded doubling principle]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.BobkovInterpolation.nonpos_of_bddAbove_of_half_step}
\leanok
\difficulty{4}
Let $s$ be a subset of a set $X$ and $f:X\to\mathbb R$. If $f(s)$ is bounded above and every $x\in s$ admits $y\in s$ with $f(x)\le f(y)/2$, then $f(x)\le0$ for all $x\in s$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Subadditivity of the square root]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.BobkovInterpolation.sqrt_add_le_add_sqrt}
\leanok
\difficulty{3}
For any real $x,y\ge0$, $\sqrt{x+y}\le\sqrt x+\sqrt y$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Even symmetric displacement]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.BobkovInterpolation.pairLength_neg}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.BobkovInterpolation.pairLength}
\difficulty{1}
For a profile $P:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$, $a,b,t,c\in\mathbb R$, and $u,v\in\mathbb R^m$, define $L(t,c)=\frac12\bigl(\sqrt{P(a+tb)^2+c+\|u+tv\|_2^2}+\sqrt{P(a-tb)^2+c+\|u-tv\|_2^2}\bigr)$. For all parameters, $L(-t,c)=L(t,c)$.
\end{lemma}

\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.BobkovInterpolation.pairLength_abs}

\begin{lemma}[Probability along a symmetric segment]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.BobkovInterpolation.probability_mem}
\leanok
\difficulty{4}
If $a+b,a-b\in[0,1]$ and $-1\le t\le1$, then $a+tb\in[0,1]$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Concavity in additional squared length]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.BobkovInterpolation.concaveOn_pairLength_clock}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.BobkovInterpolation.pairLength}
\difficulty{5}
For a profile $P:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$, $a,b,t,c\in\mathbb R$, and $u,v\in\mathbb R^m$, define $L(t,c)=\frac12\bigl(\sqrt{P(a+tb)^2+c+\|u+tv\|_2^2}+\sqrt{P(a-tb)^2+c+\|u-tv\|_2^2}\bigr)$. For every $P,a,b,u,v$, the function $c\mapsto L(1,c)$ is concave on $[0,\infty)$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Continuity in the displacement]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.BobkovInterpolation.continuousOn_pairLength_zero}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.BobkovInterpolation.pairLength,BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.BobkovInterpolation.probability_mem}
\difficulty{4}
For a profile $P:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$, $a,b,t,c\in\mathbb R$, and $u,v\in\mathbb R^m$, define $L(t,c)=\frac12\bigl(\sqrt{P(a+tb)^2+c+\|u+tv\|_2^2}+\sqrt{P(a-tb)^2+c+\|u-tv\|_2^2}\bigr)$. If $P$ is continuous on $[0,1]$ and $a+b,a-b\in[0,1]$, then $t\mapsto L(t,0)$ is continuous on $[0,1]$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Cost of an additional squared length]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.BobkovInterpolation.pairLength_clock_le}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.BobkovInterpolation.pairLength,BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.BobkovInterpolation.sqrt_add_le_add_sqrt}
\difficulty{4}
For a profile $P:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$, $a,b,t,c\in\mathbb R$, and $u,v\in\mathbb R^m$, define $L(t,c)=\frac12\bigl(\sqrt{P(a+tb)^2+c+\|u+tv\|_2^2}+\sqrt{P(a-tb)^2+c+\|u-tv\|_2^2}\bigr)$. For any real $t$ and $c\ge0$, $L(t,c)\le\sqrt c+L(t,0)$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Adaptive midpoint length bound]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.BobkovInterpolation.pairLength_adaptive_midpoint}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.BobkovInterpolation.pairLength,BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.BobkovInterpolation.probability_mem,BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.carried_midpoint}
\difficulty{6}
For a profile $P:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$, $a,b,t,c\in\mathbb R$, and $u,v\in\mathbb R^m$, define $L(t,c)=\frac12\bigl(\sqrt{P(a+tb)^2+c+\|u+tv\|_2^2}+\sqrt{P(a-tb)^2+c+\|u-tv\|_2^2}\bigr)$. Assume $P\ge0$ on $[0,1]$ and, whenever $z\pm d\in[0,1]$, $P(z)\le\bigl(\sqrt{P(z+d)^2+d^2}+\sqrt{P(z-d)^2+d^2}\bigr)/2$. If $a\pm b\in[0,1]$, $0\le t\le1$, and $c\ge0$, then $L(t,c)\le\bigl(L(1,c+((1-t)b)^2)+L(2t-1,c+((1-t)b)^2)\bigr)/2$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Lower bound by additional length]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.BobkovInterpolation.sqrt_clock_le_pairLength}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.BobkovInterpolation.pairLength}
\difficulty{4}
For a profile $P:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$, $a,b,t,c\in\mathbb R$, and $u,v\in\mathbb R^m$, define $L(t,c)=\frac12\bigl(\sqrt{P(a+tb)^2+c+\|u+tv\|_2^2}+\sqrt{P(a-tb)^2+c+\|u-tv\|_2^2}\bigr)$. For every real $t,c$, $\sqrt c\le L(t,c)$, with the real square root taken to be zero on negative arguments.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Symmetric pair contraction]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.BobkovInterpolation.pairLength_contraction}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.BobkovInterpolation.pairLength,BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.BobkovInterpolation.pairLength_le_endpoint}

For a profile $P:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$, $a,b,t,c\in\mathbb R$, and $u,v\in\mathbb R^m$, define $L(t,c)=\frac12\bigl(\sqrt{P(a+tb)^2+c+\|u+tv\|_2^2}+\sqrt{P(a-tb)^2+c+\|u-tv\|_2^2}\bigr)$.
